sources.title: Run Artemis-31B-v1.1 API (Easy Deployment & Flat-Rate Pricing)
sources.snippet: Overview TheDrummer's Artemis-31B-v1.1 is a 31 billion parameter language model, an iteration built upon the Gemma 4 template with a 32768 token context length. Developed by a software engineer with a focus on exploration and value creation in AI, this model is designed to cater to creative and entertainment-oriented applications.
